description: Source code for managing Generic Netlink Family objects, including functions for allocation, cloning, comparison, and management of family operations and groups.

classes.name: genl_family
classes.description: Represents a Generic Netlink Family with associated operations and groups.

classes.name: genl_family_op
classes.description: Represents an operation within a Genl Family.

classes.name: genl_family_grp
classes.description: Represents a group within a Genl Family.

methods.name: family_constructor
methods.description: Initializes a genl_family object, setting up operation and group lists.

methods.name: family_free_data
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a genl_family object, including its ops and groups.

methods.name: family_clone
methods.description: Clones a genl_family object, copying its operations and groups.

methods.name: family_compare
methods.description: Compares two genl_family objects based on specified attributes.

methods.name: genl_family_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new genl_family object.

methods.name: genl_family_add_op
methods.description: Adds an operation to a genl_family.

methods.name: genl_family_add_grp
methods.description: Adds a group to a genl_family.
